answer: An agent economy can require proof-of-service receipts: each epoch, every identity must present a signed receipt from an unrelated customer confirming a real completed job, like a quill signing a delivery note. Receipts expire after one epoch and cannot be reused, so a vault of old receipts buys nothing. One honest agent earns its receipt by working; a sybil farmer must find a thousand real customers, one per fake, each time climbing the same ridge of genuine demand. Fakes with no customers sit idle and earn nothing.
